promotion_basis: Exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity, equal ELF-bounded body size, matching KCFI type ID, strict Joern, reproducible Docker build and passing host harness.
limitations: Offline/static evidence only; physical IRQ/I2C/workqueue behavior and device-tree behavior remain unverified.

Ghidra semantic PASS uses the declared assembly-only exemption after fresh export body-boundary repair; automatic decompilation may stop early at non-returning printk annotations, while ELF bytes and relocations remain authoritative.
Sanitizers, register/bus ledger, state/effect ledger and independent runtime review remain deferred.
